### THE DEFECT SHAPE, worth carrying to any future lab
A task states a SPECIFIC value, the handler checks only that SOMETHING was entered, and the
success message then ECHOES THE STUDENT'S WRONG ANSWER BACK as confirmation. That last part is
what makes it worse than a silent false pass -- the lab teaches the wrong thing on the way out.
pl300 task 6 displayed "configured: Weekly at 23:00" for a task naming Daily at 06:00.
